faq.q: What is an AI image to video tool?
faq.a: It animates a still picture into a short video. For sellers, that means a product photo becomes a UGC-style ad with motion, a voiceover and captions.

faq.q: How does a photo become a video?
faq.a: Upload the image and describe the motion you want, and the AI generates the movement. Add a script, a voiceover and on-screen text, and the clip is ready in minutes.

faq.q: What do you gain by making video from a photo?
faq.a: More ads from the photos you already own. You skip the shoot, get a finished clip in minutes, and make as many versions as your campaign needs.

faq.q: Can I post these clips on social?
faq.a: Yes. Size each clip for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts and post it as an ad or as an organic video.

faq.q: How can a store use this for product marketing?
faq.a: Show the product in action, reveal a before-and-after, run social video ads, or add a video to your Amazon listing. Each one starts from the same photo.

faq.q: Can I make explainers and tutorials?
faq.a: Yes. Keep one AI avatar and one script style for every lesson, so feature walkthroughs and training clips look consistent without re-recording.

faq.q: Can I add a voiceover or an AI avatar?
faq.a: Yes. Write your own script or let AI draft one, pick a voice, and add an AI avatar to present the product on camera.

faq.q: Which aspect ratios can I pick?
faq.a: Choose 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Stories, 1:1 for the feed or 16:9 for YouTube. 4:3 and 3:4 are there too.

definition.title: What Is AI Image to Video?
paras: AI image to video turns a still product photo into a moving UGC-style clip. Shoppers see one action, and they can also hear a short script from an avatar.
